title: Sliding Doors
score_note: the premise is the structure: the tube doors ARE the meet-cute

beats.name: THE DOORS
cap: she is fired from one job and loses
a second; the tube doors close
beats.tag: the premise arrives in one beat

beats.name: SHE CATCHES IT
cap: in one line she gets home early,
in the other she is later than she knows
beats.tag: the film splits and never says so

beats.name: SHE MISSES IT
cap: the other Helen takes the next train,
is hurt, and goes to hospital
beats.tag: the same beat, the other life

beats.name: TWO FLATS, ONE LIE
cap: Gerry is cheating in both lines;
only one Helen finds out tonight

beats.name: THE FRIEND'S CAFE
cap: Anna keeps her honest in one line;
in the other she has nobody to tell
beats.tag: the best friend, doing the work

beats.name: THE NEW ONE
cap: James in this line, Gerry's pity in the
other, which is not the line pictured here

beats.name: PREGNANT
cap: this Helen is pregnant and planning;
the other is alone, off to the right

beats.name: THE STAIRS
cap: the hospital, the fall, the thing
neither version of her saw coming

beats.name: ONE HELEN
cap: the lines end in the same corridor,
and only one of her walks out of it

beats.name: THE LIFT
cap: she meets James on the way up,
in the life she gets to keep
